verdict.rationale: Greptile's official CLI can run headlessly in CI: its docs say to export GREPTILE_API_KEY and run `greptile review` for CI or self-hosted deployments, and `greptile review --agent` emits raw text findings for programmatic consumers. The core product also reviews every PR automatically without a human in the loop. Missing for 10: documented CI pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions config) and exit-code/machine-readable (JSON) output semantics for gating builds, plus independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
